response.rationale: Indonesian “ojek” is correct for motorcycle taxi, though the dictionary sense also includes bicycles. Malaysian “teksi motosikal” is a valid transparent expression and is officially attested, but its everyday commonness is not established; the card should not present it as an unqualified common equivalent. No false-friend contrast is supplied.
